question: neo drives the only networked link, so it alone can reproduce lab2's latency. It has 5.9 h of room (6 h minus 0.1 h left on the sentinel, nothing queued). The plan uses about 282 min including both possible confirmations, which leaves margin in case netem and the CPU cap stretch sample times. e51c1df1329a is the newest xs build on both neo and mars; no -tune build is staged on mars, so tuning (step 2) waits for a reproduced gap.
